acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given the application runs in test, When a database query is executed by UserServiceTest, Then it runs against the correctly matching Postgres datastore without engine mismatch errors.
Given the test suite is invoked, When the relevant local verification command runs, Then it passes cleanly against the configured Postgres test datastore.
notes: Configured io.zonky.test:embedded-postgres in pom.xml and created PostgresTestContainerInitializer to dynamically start embedded Postgres for Spring Boot tests.
